capabilities.name: Multi-Part Chunked Private Vault Backup & 1-Click Disaster Recovery
capabilities.purpose: Provides deterministic, multi-part chunked Git bundle snapshots, encrypted secrets, and auxiliary cache archiving to a private GitHub vault with 100% pure remote isolated restore capability.

inScope: Atomic Git bundle creation capturing complete commit history and all branches
Automatic 45MB chunk splitting to strictly comply with GitHub 100MB blob limit
AES-256-GCM authenticated secrets encryption with PBKDF2-SHA512 KDF
Auxiliary non-git state packaging (pre-indexed 50MB retrieval cache, circuit breakers, logs)
Pure remote-to-isolated disaster recovery with 100% SHA-256 manifest parity
7-Daily, 4-Weekly, 12-Monthly retention management with sole survivor invariant
nonGoals: Modifying or rewriting the original main repository history
Distributing plaintext secrets to remote repositories
Overwriting active live directories without explicit safety flags

inputsPrerequisites: Target GitHub private vault remote URL

dependencies.rationale: Requires authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets.enc
Requires process PID mutex locking to prevent race conditions during backup

rulesConstraints: Master Brain origin remote (k9x-774b-m20.git) must remain strictly untouched
Chunk sizes must not exceed 90MB to guarantee compliance with GitHub 100MB limit
Must verify all SHA-256 digests before bundle reassembly and git checkout
Retention engine must never delete the sole surviving snapshot (PRESERVE_SOLE_SURVIVOR)
acceptanceCriteria: Git bundle verify passes cleanly on reassembled parts
Clone from bundle reproduces exact Git HEAD commit
Restored files match backup-manifest.json with 100% substantive parity
Zero modifications to live working tree
verificationMethods: Pure remote isolated recovery test: node 04_WORKFLOWS/factory-engine/test-remote-to-isolated-restore.mjs

knownFailureModes.mode: GitHub HTTPS chunk timeout on slow uplinks (HTTP 408)
knownFailureModes.mitigation: git config http.postBuffer 524288000 (500 MB) configured in vault cache

knownFailureModes.mode: execSync ENOBUFS buffer overflow on status check
knownFailureModes.mitigation: maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024 (64 MB) explicitly set on child process runners

recoveryProcedures: node scripts/disaster-recovery.mjs --restore-to-original --confirm-destructive-overwrite (creates automatic pre-restore safety copy first)

evidenceProvenance.notes: Verified in Phase B.12, B.13, and B.14 with 74/74 assertions passing

applicableConditions: Requires authenticated gh CLI access to private vault repo
relatedLearnings: Rule 1687 (Vault Disaster Recovery & Air-Gapped Purity Invariant)
Rule 1688 (Disaster Recovery Purity & Auxiliary State Dual Verification)
Rule 1689 (Buffer Overflow Prevention & Concurrency Mutex Defense)
knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: Daily recurring run at 02:00:30 AM is pending natural confirmation on Task Scheduler
Restore to live directory requires manual --confirm-destructive-overwrite flag

capabilities.name: Authenticated Cryptographic Secrets Encryption & Key Hierarchy
capabilities.purpose: Protects sensitive credentials and API keys via authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption with PBKDF2-SHA512 key derivation, eliminating plaintext leakage in repositories.

inScope: AES-256-GCM encryption with 12-byte IV and 16-byte authentication tag
PBKDF2-SHA512 key derivation with 100,000 iterations and 32-byte salt
Strict verification of authentication tag before returning decrypted buffer
Hierarchical passphrase resolution (CLI flag, env var, machine entropy fallback)
nonGoals: Hardware Security Module (HSM) physical key storage
Cloud KMS vendor lock-in dependencies

inputsPrerequisites: Optional custom passphrase or master environment secret
rulesConstraints: Plaintext secrets must NEVER be committed to Git or pushed to remote repositories
Decryption must throw an explicit error on wrong passphrase or tampered ciphertext
Zero plaintext leakage into console logs or terminal reports
expectedOutputs: secrets.enc binary payload with 32-byte salt, 12-byte IV, 16-byte tag, and ciphertext
acceptanceCriteria: Decrypted data strictly matches original plaintext bytes
Tampered ciphertext or IV fails AES-256-GCM authentication check
Wrong passphrase produces explicit authentication failure

knownFailureModes.mode: Ciphertext bit tampering or corrupted transmission
knownFailureModes.mitigation: AES-256-GCM 16-byte authentication tag fails, blocking partial corruption
Machine entropy fallback resolves deterministic local key when configured

recoveryProcedures: Provide explicit --passphrase parameter or set BRAIN_VAULT_PASSPHRASE environment variable

evidenceProvenance.notes: Verified AES-256-GCM roundtrip and auth tag enforcement

applicableConditions: All Node.js platforms supporting native node:crypto
relatedLearnings: Rule 1687 (Vault Disaster Recovery & Air-Gapped Purity Invariant)
knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: Passphrase cannot be recovered if master environment secret and passphrase are both lost

capabilities.name: Process PID Mutex Locking with Stale Crash Recovery
capabilities.purpose: Guarantees race-free mutual exclusion for long-running batch operations, background daemons, and scheduled tasks using PID tracking and automatic crash-lock eviction.

inScope: File-based mutex lock with active PID and ISO-8601 start timestamp
Detection of stale locks from crashed processes (> 2 hours old or non-existent PID)
Rejection of secondary concurrent processes with explicit exit code 1
Automatic clean release of lock in process finally block
nonGoals: Distributed multi-datacenter consensus (e.g. Raft, Paxos)
Replacing database transaction isolation

rulesConstraints: Only one backup or heavy sync process may execute concurrently
Active locks must block new processes immediately without corrupting state
Stale locks from dead PIDs must be automatically purged
expectedOutputs: Temporary lock file containing { pid, startedAt }
Clean deletion upon normal exit or graceful termination
acceptanceCriteria: Active PID blocks second concurrent process
Dead PID or expired lock (> 2h) is cleaned up automatically
Finally block cleans lock file on normal or error exit

knownFailureModes.mode: Hard power cut / OS kill leaving abandoned lock file
knownFailureModes.mitigation: Stale lock eviction checks process.kill(pid, 0) and 2-hour timeout

recoveryProcedures: Manually remove lock file if operator confirms no process is active

evidenceProvenance.notes: Verified against dead PID 999999 and live process.pid

applicableConditions: All operating systems supporting process signal 0 checks
relatedLearnings: Rule 1689 (Buffer Overflow Prevention & Concurrency Mutex Defense)
knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: Stale lock threshold is set to 2 hours; tasks running longer than 2h require lock heartbeating

capabilities.name: Sub-15ms BM25 Hybrid Knowledge Retrieval & Token Budgeting
capabilities.purpose: Enables compatible AI agents to rapidly search, rank, and target verified engineering patterns, core rules, and skills with sub-15ms latency and strict token budgets.

inScope: BM25 ranking with customizable k1 and b parameters
Exact rule targeting (e.g. 'Rule 15', 'Rule 24')
Strict token budgeting preventing context window overflow
Pre-computed persistent inverted index in .project-brain/cache/retrieval-index.json
Inverted index cache invalidation based on source file hash changes
nonGoals: Full-text search over arbitrary external non-brain directories
Heavy remote vector database dependencies (e.g. Pinecone, Weaviate)

inputsPrerequisites: Optional options { maxTokens, domain, exactRuleOnly, customRoot }

dependencies.rationale: Requires locked 16-folder taxonomy paths to discover source knowledge

rulesConstraints: Query latency must remain sub-15ms on cached index
Token budget must strictly truncate responses to prevent LLM context exhaustion
Cache must re-index automatically when source knowledge files are modified
expectedOutputs: { results: [{ id, title, score, snippet, path }], totalDocuments, latencyMs }
acceptanceCriteria: Exact rule lookups rank target rule at position #1
Corpus covers > 250 engineering rules and skills
Index building completes in < 2000ms; cached queries execute in < 15ms

knownFailureModes.mode: Cache index out of sync after manual file edits
knownFailureModes.mitigation: SHA-256 hash comparison against source files triggers auto-rebuild

recoveryProcedures: buildSearchIndex(true) forces complete fresh index regeneration

evidenceProvenance.notes: Verified in test-retrieval-engine.mjs and isolated restore tests (8,237 documents healthy)

applicableConditions: All Node.js environments with file system access
knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: Corpus size of 8,251 documents takes ~2.2s on initial cold rebuild from disk before warm cache is established

capabilities.name: Universal Task Contract & Pre-Flight Context Enforcement
capabilities.purpose: Structures, bounds, and verifies coding tasks through pre-flight context checks, risk classification, explicit constraints, and observable completion evidence.

inScope: Task Contract generation and validation
Binding target objectives to specific acceptance criteria
Pre-flight dependency and environment checks before execution
Verification proof collection before marking tasks completed
nonGoals: Replacing human project management systems (Jira, Linear)
Executing unvetted shell commands autonomously without safety barriers

rulesConstraints: No task may be marked completed without passing empirical verification tests
High-risk or destructive actions require explicit human authorization
Surgical fix principle: change only minimal necessary lines
expectedOutputs: Validated Task Contract object and checkpoint record
acceptanceCriteria: Valid contracts pass validation schema
Contracts missing objectives or criteria are rejected
Execution output matches declared acceptance criteria

knownFailureModes.mode: Task scope creep or goal drift during multi-step execution
knownFailureModes.mitigation: Strict acceptance criteria enforcement prevents completing until all criteria pass

recoveryProcedures: Roll back to pre-task git checkpoint and re-scope contract

evidenceProvenance.notes: Verified with 29/29 assertions in isolated sandbox

applicableConditions: Any pair-programming or autonomous agent workflow
knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: Multi-day asynchronous workflows require external session resumption tokens

capabilities.name: Project Factory Zero-Copy Environment Scaffolding
capabilities.purpose: Initializes certified development environments for new projects by generating 11 mandatory governance files and zero-copy Master Brain bridges without polluting business logic.

inScope: Generation of 11 mandatory project-local brain files (PROJECT_CONTEXT.md, etc.)
Creation of .project-brain/brain-bridge.json zero-copy bridge
Strict adherence to Rule 1670: Environment bootstrap ONLY, zero product logic generation
Certification of ENVIRONMENT READY : CERTIFIED status
nonGoals: Generating web application pages, UI components, or calculators
Duplicating Master Brain knowledge files into child repos

inputsPrerequisites: Project architectural profile (Astro, Next.js, Node, etc.)

dependencies.rationale: Requires knowledge taxonomy to establish proper brain bridge configuration

rulesConstraints: Rule 1670: Project Factory = Environment Initialization Only. Never generate product components.
Child projects connect via read-only zero-copy bridge
Bootstrap must stop at ENVIRONMENT READY : CERTIFIED
acceptanceCriteria: All 11 mandatory files exist and pass schema checks
Zero product components generated during bootstrap
Child repo connects to Master Brain without file duplication

knownFailureModes.mode: Attempting to generate product features during scaffolding
knownFailureModes.mitigation: Schema validator strictly rejects any non-governance component files

recoveryProcedures: Purge non-governance files and re-run bootstrap in strict environment mode

evidenceProvenance.notes: Verified across onlinefreeprotractor.com and test harness projects

applicableConditions: Any fresh or existing child project connecting to AI-Builder-Brain
knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: Astro and Next.js project profiles supported; mobile frameworks (React Native/Flutter) profiles pending

capabilities.name: 16-Folder Canonical Knowledge Taxonomy & Routing
capabilities.purpose: Governs the durable classification, routing, and access policies for all construction intelligence across the 16 locked canonical folders (00_START_HERE through 15_METADATA).

inScope: Enforcement of 16 locked canonical folders (00_ to 15_)
Machine-readable routing destination registry in 15_METADATA/knowledge-taxonomy.json
Schema format and harvester destination validation
Prevention of arbitrary root folder proliferation
nonGoals: Allowing arbitrary renaming or deletion of canonical folders
Storing temporary build artifacts in canonical knowledge folders

inputsPrerequisites: File path and incoming knowledge category
rulesConstraints: Canonical 16-folder architecture is permanent and immutable
Incoming knowledge must route to designated folder per routing_policy
Untrusted external content must route to 11_INBOX staging first
expectedOutputs: Valid routing destination path matching canonical folder schema
acceptanceCriteria: All 16 canonical folders exist and contain valid schema files
Taxonomy JSON validates with 16 distinct folder keys

knownFailureModes.mode: Subagent or script creates arbitrary folder at root (e.g. 'temp/', 'data/')
knownFailureModes.mitigation: Pre-commit and audit hooks flag and reject non-canonical root directories

recoveryProcedures: Re-route files into appropriate canonical folder (e.g. 11_INBOX or .project-brain/cache)

evidenceProvenance.notes: Verified across Phase A, B, B.12, B.13, and B.14 audits

knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: External repositories containing deep nested non-standard directories must be flattened into canonical taxonomy

capabilities.name: Persistent Engineering Pattern Extraction & Promotion
capabilities.purpose: Harvests proven engineering patterns, bug fixes, and architectural invariants from development sessions into persistent dossiers and promotes them to universal rules.

inScope: Extraction of verified engineering patterns from forensic autopsies
Recording in 07_PROJECT_LEARNING/ dossiers with full provenance
Promotion to 05_KNOWLEDGE/engineering-patterns.md (Rules 1-259+)
Persistent ledger updates in LEARNINGS.md
nonGoals: Promoting unverified guesses or theoretical opinions to universal rules
Overwriting existing rules without backwards compatibility

inputsPrerequisites: Verified bug fix or architectural implementation
Empirical test results and evidence logs

dependencies.rationale: Requires taxonomy routing to store dossiers in 07_PROJECT_LEARNING

rulesConstraints: Promotion requires empirical test proof and provenance citation
Rules must be formulated as actionable, testable invariants
Candidate learnings must not automatically become canonical without verification
acceptanceCriteria: Pattern has verified problem, solution, test evidence, and provenance
Rule is indexed by retrieval engine and searchable

knownFailureModes.mode: Duplicate rule creation for existing known pattern
knownFailureModes.mitigation: Retrieval engine similarity check against existing patterns before promotion

recoveryProcedures: Merge duplicate rules into unified pattern referencing both incident sources

evidenceProvenance.notes: Rules 1-259+ and Rules 1669-1689 codified with full provenance

knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: Automated de-duplication across similar rules relies on BM25 similarity; semantic embeddings pending Phase F

capabilities.name: 54-Locale Multilingual SEO & Trailing-Slash Parity Engine
capabilities.purpose: Guides autonomous construction of high-performance internationalized web products with strict hreflang bidirectional parity, automated sitemaps, and canonical routing invariants.

inScope: 54-locale internationalization matrix and hreflang reciprocal linking
Rule 15: Strict canonical trailing-slash parity in SSG edge routing
Rule 24: Bidirectional hreflang self-referencing alternate link tags
Rules 79-88: Forensic technical SEO crawlability and indexation verification
nonGoals: Black-hat keyword stuffing or cloaking techniques
Machine translation without human-grade linguistic validation

inputsPrerequisites: Supported locale codes array (e.g. en, es, hi, de, ja, fr)

dependencies.rationale: Requires retrieval engine to extract locale-specific SEO patterns

rulesConstraints: Rule 15: Every internal link and canonical tag must match edge server trailing-slash behavior exactly
Rule 24: Every hreflang annotation must have reciprocal backlink from the target locale page
Decouple technical 200 OK HTTP readiness from search engine indexability
expectedOutputs: Bidirectional hreflang link tags on all pages
Zero 301 redirect hops on internal canonical links
acceptanceCriteria: All hreflang links resolve to 200 OK without redirects
x-default fallback tag is correctly assigned
Trailing slash configuration matches SSG build output

knownFailureModes.mode: Trailing slash mismatch causing 301 redirect chains on internal links
knownFailureModes.mitigation: Enforce Rule 15: append/strip trailing slash globally at build config

knownFailureModes.mode: Orphaned locale pages missing reciprocal hreflang alternate tags
knownFailureModes.mitigation: Automated matrix test verifies all 54 locales link to each other

recoveryProcedures: Run hreflang parity validator and update canonical component template

evidenceProvenance.notes: Verified in production on onlinefreeprotractor.com and knowledge tests

applicableConditions: All multilingual web applications and Astro SSG projects
knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: 54 locales currently verified; right-to-left (RTL) locales (Arabic/Hebrew) styling checklist pending Phase G

capabilities.name: 24/7 Autonomous Background Cloud Harvester
capabilities.purpose: Continuously mines open-source software patterns, commits, and releases from GitHub repositories via GitHub Actions on a 20-minute cron schedule.

inScope: GitHub Actions autonomous workflow on */20 * * * * cron
Mining candidate repositories listed in repos.txt
Circuit breaker rate limit protection (.harvest-locks/ai-key-circuit.json)
Execution logs in daemon-harvester.log
nonGoals: DDoS or abusing GitHub API quotas
Promoting raw harvested code directly without validation

inputsPrerequisites: GitHub Actions workflow dispatcher token or cron trigger

dependencies.rationale: Requires taxonomy to route harvested findings into 11_INBOX and 07_PROJECT_LEARNING

rulesConstraints: Must obey GitHub API rate limits and backoff upon receiving 403/429
Must record harvest locks to avoid concurrent duplicate clones
Raw harvest data must stage in 11_INBOX before validation
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow triggers automatically every 20 minutes
Checkpoints record last processed commit SHA

knownFailureModes.mode: GitHub API secondary rate limit reached
knownFailureModes.mitigation: Master circuit breaker pauses harvesting until window resets

evidenceProvenance.notes: Cron schedule intact and active; full 10,000 repo scaling planned for Phase E

knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: Scaling to 10,000 repositories requires prioritized queue and multi-token rotation (planned for Phase E)

capabilities.name: Automated WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility & Contrast Auditing

inScope: Color contrast verification (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
ARIA landmark and label hierarchy checking
Keyboard focus indicator and tabindex validation
nonGoals: Manual human screen-reader usability testing

inputsPrerequisites: Component HTML/CSS markup or rendered page URL
rulesConstraints: All interactive controls must have accessible names and focus rings
expectedOutputs: Accessibility audit report with pass/fail per WCAG criterion
acceptanceCriteria: Zero contrast ratio violations < 4.5:1
All buttons and links have visible focus states
verificationMethods: Automated a11y audit suite (scheduled for Phase G)

knownFailureModes.mode: Low contrast placeholder text or subtle disabled states
knownFailureModes.mitigation: Automated contrast formula flags colors below threshold

recoveryProcedures: Adjust color hex code to compliant contrast value

evidenceProvenance.notes: Skill documentation present; formal automated runtime test suite pending Phase G

knownGapsUnresolvedQuestions: Automated test runner in factory-engine pending implementation in Phase G
